vo.en: You cannot lift your ring finger.

visual.description: A man's hand pressed flat against a dark wooden table, with one finger visibly twitching but failing to move.

vo.en: Put your hand flat. Fold your middle finger under so the knuckle touches the table. Keep the rest straight.

visual.description: Close up of a hand demonstrating the specific tucking position on a clean surface.

vo.en: Lift your thumb. Easy. Index? Simple. Even the pinky works. Your brain thinks it’s in total control.

visual.description: A sequence of different fingers lifting one by one while the middle finger remains tucked.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. Try lifting your ring finger. Seriously, try as hard as you can.

visual.description: A man looking directly at the camera with a shocked or frustrated expression, gesturing toward his hand.

vo.en: You’re stuck. These fingers share the same extensor tendon. Pinning one down mechanically locks the other. It’s a hardware limitation.

visual.description: Abstract animation of mechanical gears or intertwined cables being pulled tight and locking up.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow’s brain test and comment GLITCH if you failed. It’s crazy how...

visual.description: A hand holding a smartphone and tapping the screen quickly to scroll through content.
